license.name: MIT License

notes: The repo README names https://orbit.kiwi as the official documentation site, but orbit.kiwi could not be reached from the research environment (DNS ENOTFOUND / proxy 502, host outside the session's allowed network domains), so it is NOT recorded; homepageUrl uses the official repo and docsUrl/storybookUrl the official Storybook at kiwicom.github.io/orbit. name: Pluralsight Design System
summary: Pluralsight's design system for its technology-learning platform. The current generation, Pando, is documented on a public zeroheight site (reached from design.pluralsight.com) covering foundations, components and tokens; the earlier React library (PSDS Classic) remains on GitHub in maintenance mode.

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.notes: Classic repo LICENSE is Apache 2.0; Pando npm packages declare 'Apache 2.0'. Licence of any non-public Pando v1 code is unknown.

notes: design.pluralsight.com and pando.pluralsight.com both redirect to the Pando zeroheight site (page data shows has_password:false, i.e. public); it lists foundations, ~50 components, design tokens, 'Pando v1' migration guides and legacy 'PSDS Classic' docs. Pando npm packages (@pluralsight/react, headless-styles, panda-preset) point to github.com/pluralsight/pando, which returns 404 publicly; their last public publishes are 'next' prereleases on 2024-08-09 (latest tag 0.7.1, 2023-09-07). The classic repo README states it is in maintenance mode and points to a 'TVA project' at pluralsight.github.io/tva, which returns 404. Because the current generation's code/distribution is not publicly verifiable and no public release exists within 12 months, maintenanceStatus is 'unknown'. The zeroheight site links a Figma 'Pando UI kit (Web)' file that redirects to Figma login (not public), so figmaUrl is null. The referenced storybook.pluralsight.com does not resolve.

name: Braid Design System
summary: Braid is SEEK's open-source, themeable design system for its employment-marketplace products, distributed as a React component library with multiple brand themes and a Playroom prototyping environment. It superseded the now-deprecated SEEK Style Guide.
notes: Entry covers the SEEK lineage: the older SEEK Style Guide (seek-style-guide, React + CSS Modules + Less; docs still online at seek-oss.github.io/seek-style-guide) is deprecated on npm 'in favour of braid-design-system' (last publish 42.0.0, 2020-07-29), so both names map to this one entry rather than two systems. Braid docs include components, foundations, patterns/templates, guides, releases and a Playroom. Organization URL uses au.seek.com/about (www.seek.com/www.seek.com.au return bot-protection 403s to the checker). No official Figma community file was found, so figmaUrl is null.

name: Thumbprint
summary: Thumbprint is Thumbtack's design system, open-sourced with React components, SCSS and atomic CSS utilities, design tokens and separate iOS and Android libraries; documentation (guidelines, components, tokens) is published at thumbprint.design.

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.notes: Web repo and npm packages are Apache-2.0; iOS and Android READMEs also state Apache License 2.0.

notes: READMEs say Thumbprint's primary purpose is Thumbtack's own products and it is open-sourced for transparency. Native code lives in thumbtack/thumbprint-ios and thumbtack/thumbprint-android (Android via JitPack); their UI framework (UIKit vs SwiftUI, Views vs Compose) was not extracted, so only web frameworks are listed. maintenanceStatus 'unknown': repo is not archived, but the newest npm release is 14.18.2 (2024-04-03), >12 months ago, and commit activity could not be verified (GitHub API blocked).
